# AMD — Catalysts

## TL;DR

Q1 2026 earnings on **May 5, 2026 (after market close, 5 PM ET)** is the live binary catalyst — 1 trading day away. Consensus revenue: ~$9.84–$9.89 billion (~33% YoY growth); EPS consensus ~$1.28–$1.29 (+34% YoY). New since prior run: AMD signed a **6GW deal with OpenAI** for Instinct MI450 GPU deployment (first 1GW in H2 2026), and a similar 6GW agreement with Meta — these are structurally significant expansions of the Meta deal already in the thesis. Cathie Wood sold ~$79.9M of AMD shares ahead of the Q1 print — the largest recent institutional sell signal. Stock at $360 now exceeds even the highest consensus price target ($358 Evercore ISI bull case); the street consensus is $291.52 (54-analyst panel). Beat-and-lower on Q2 guidance (25% tariff headwinds on AI chip exports) remains the primary earnings trap.

## Upcoming events

| Date | Event | Expected impact |
|---|---|---|
| May 5, 2026 (after close, 5 PM ET) | Q1 2026 earnings | Binary — revenue consensus ~$9.84-9.89B; EPS consensus ~$1.28-$1.29 |
| July 23, 2026 | AMD "Advancing AI 2026" flagship event, Moscone Center SF | Positive — product roadmap reveal |
| H2 2026 | MI450 GPU first delivery (OpenAI 1GW + Meta deployment) | Positive if on-schedule; negative if delayed |
| H2 2026 | Helios rack-scale platform launch | Positive — multi-GPU hyperscale positioning |
| Ongoing | TSMC tariff exemption decision | Potential positive relief if enacted |
| Pending | Kevin Warsh Fed chair Senate confirmation (May 15 Powell exit) | Macro: potential hawkish shift risk |

Sources: web_research/AMD.json run 20260504_134825; swing_catalyst_news signal run 20260504_134825.

## Recent news synthesis (within 14 days)

**Positive:**
- **OpenAI 6GW MI450 deal** — AMD signed a 6GW AI infrastructure deal with OpenAI for Instinct MI450 GPU deployment; first 1GW in H2 2026. A parallel 6GW agreement with Meta includes MI450 GPUs and 6th-gen EPYC Venice CPUs (source: web_research/AMD.json, 20260504_134825).
- **Intel Q1 blowout read-through** — Intel +24.89% on Q1 2026 beat driven by AI CPU demand; DA Davidson revised AMD 2026 revenue estimate $2B above consensus based on the x86 read-through (source: web_research/AMD.json, 20260504_134825).
- **DA Davidson upgrade** — Buy/$375 PT (raised from $220), citing structural CPU demand from agentic AI deployment. Stifel PT raised to $320. Envision Research upgraded to Buy (source: web_research/AMD.json, 20260504_134825).
- **Strong April rally** — AMD surged ~74% in April on AI capex cycle confirmation (Meta $60B, Amazon, Alphabet expanding); record Q4 2025 Data Center revenue $5.38B (+34% YoY) (source: web_research/AMD.json, 20260504_134825).

**Negative:**
- **Cathie Wood sold ~$79.9M of AMD** ahead of Q1 print — largest institutional sell signal in recent history; Ark's ARK Invest typically signals near-term valuation concern with pre-earnings trims (source: web_research/AMD.json, 20260504_134825).
- **Northland downgrade** — downgraded to Market Perform from Outperform, PT $260, citing competitive landscape. One TipRanks analyst also cut to Hold on valuation days before earnings (source: web_research/AMD.json, 20260504_134825).
- **Stock above consensus PT** — AMD at $360 exceeds average analyst PT of $291.52 (54-analyst panel) and the highest bull target ($365 range). Sell-the-news risk on beat-and-lower Q2 guidance with 25% tariff headwinds on AI chip exports (source: web_research/AMD.json, 20260504_134825).
- **25% tariff on advanced AI chips** — ongoing margin headwind on MI325X/MI450; multi-year hyperscaler contracts limit pass-through ability (source: swing_catalyst_news, 20260504_134825).

## Analyst consensus (as of May 4, 2026)

- **Rating:** Buy consensus — 37 Buy, 12 Hold, 0 Sell (54-analyst panel, updated from prior 34-analyst count)
- **Avg price target:** ~$291.52; median $290.50; range $220–$365
- **Bull targets:** DA Davidson $375, Stifel $320, Envision Research Buy
- **Bear targets:** Northland $260 (downgrade April 27); one TipRanks analyst Hold on valuation

CEO Lisa Su sold ~$16M in March 2026. Cathie Wood (Ark Invest) sold ~$79.9M ahead of earnings print. Board-level insider distribution: 2:1 sellers vs buyers (source: swing_catalyst_news, run 20260504_134825).
